correctness.rationale: All 29524 projective ternary cubic forms, 364 projective quadratics and 13 linear forms were explicitly enumerated with complete coefficient and projective-point normalization. Exact derivative evaluations and line masks found precisely 3744 degree-three coverings and no smaller ones. The projective coordinate-generator orbits have 936+1872+936 distinct members exhausting these 3744, with geometrically smooth representatives verified by direct Jacobian arguments and Gröbner charts. Computation is finite and fully reproducible in verify.py.

value.rationale: Asgarli--Ghioca explicitly ask the minimum degree of irreducible tangent-filling plane curves; the first odd prime field q=3 is a natural boundary test. This theorem gives both the sharp degree and every minimizer up to projective equivalence, with distinct four/six/seven-point strata and proof that all minimizers are smooth. Exact finite classification is useful without a general-q extension.
